senses.gloss: (or קוּשׁ) (b. h.; to join closely; to collect (v.
units: Targ. Zeph. II, 1), esp. to gather wood, rubbish &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> <he>כמה … שׁיָקוֹשּׁוּ אותה עכשיו שקָשַׁשְׁתָּה וכ׳</he> how many working men should I have needed to gather it! Now that thou hast done it, come and receive thy reward; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 313">Yalk. Is. 313</cite> <he>שׁיְקוֹשְׁשׁוּ</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 76:8">Yalk. Gen. 76</cite> <he>שׁיְקַשְׁקְשׁוּ … שׁקִישְׁקשְׁתָּ</he>.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="S02265">same</cite>. Y. Snh. V, 22ᵈ top <he>מְקוֹשֵׁשׁ משום וכ׳</he> of which crime was the gatherer of sticks (<cite ref="Numbers 15:32">Num. XV, 32</cite>) found guilty? of plucking, or of harvesting?; <cite ref="Shabbat 96b">Sabb. 96ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 113">Sifré Num. 113</cite>.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 113:1">Ib.</cite> <he>ומצאו אותו מק׳ וכ׳</he> they found him gathering &c.
